title: Foresight-England: Development of a National-Scale Generative AI Model of Electronic Health Records for Medical Event Prediction across the COVID-19 Pandemic
abstract: arXiv:2608.16273v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Foresight-England (Foresight-E) is the first national-scale generative foundation model of electronic health records (EHRs), developed as a research pilot strictly for COVID-19 research. We evaluated its ability to model the direct and indirect effects of the pandemic. Trained from scratch entirely within the NHS England Secure Data Environment, Foresight-E is a 243-million-parameter transformer decoder. It was trained and evaluated on de-identified, longitudinal EHRs of approximately 61 million individuals, integrating primary/secondary care, death registrations, and COVID-19 data. Training and validation used a 90% subset (54.9 million) spanning November 2018 to December 2022; the remaining 10% (6.1 million) was held out for evaluation. Foresight-E models patient timelines autoregressively, predicting the next medical event given their prior history. translated_title: 前瞻英格兰：开发英国国家级生成式电子健康记录模型用于COVID-19疫情期间的医疗事件预测
translated_abstract: 摘要：前瞻英格兰（Foresight-E）是首个国家级规模的电子健康记录（EHR）生成式基础模型，作为研究试点严格用于COVID-19研究。我们评估了其模拟疫情直接和间接影响的能力。Foresight-E完全在NHS英格兰安全数据环境中从头训练，是一个拥有2.43亿参数的Transformer解码器。它在大约6100万人的去标识化纵向EHR数据上进行了训练和评估，整合了初级/二级医疗、死亡登记和COVID-19数据。训练和验证使用了90%的子集（5490万人），覆盖2018年11月至2022年12月；剩余的10%（610万人）被保留用于评估。Foresight-E以自回归方式模拟患者时间线，根据既往病史预测下一个医疗事件。在推理时，它以零样本方式运行，预测其约4万代码词汇表中的任何概念。
tldr: 该论文提出了Foresight-E，这是首个基于英国6100万人电子健康记录的国家级生成式基础模型，能零样本预测医疗事件并模拟疫情的直接和间接影响。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Foresight-E, the first national-scale generative foundation model of electronic health records based on 61 million individuals in England, capable of zero-shot medical event prediction and modeling the direct and indirect effects of the pandemic.
